# OUxSBLI GitHub contribution templates

This directory contains the GitHub templates and contribution workflow used by
OUxSBLI.

## Issue types

- Bug Report
- Feature Request
- Validation Issue

## Discussion

Use GitHub Discussions for broader technical conversations. In particular,
use the Performance Ideas category for GPU, MPI, memory, kernel, I/O, and
algorithmic optimization ideas.

## Pull Requests

Pull Requests should describe implementation, validation, numerical impact,
and performance impact where applicable.
